name: Balme Library
description: The main university library with extensive collections across all disciplines. It provides study spaces, computer labs, and research support services.

name: Great Hall
description: The iconic Great Hall of University of Legon, used for major ceremonies including graduation and special events. Known for its distinctive architecture.

name: College of Humanities
description: Home to departments including English, History, Philosophy, Modern Languages, and the Study of Religions. Offers undergraduate and graduate programs.

name: Department of Computer Science
description: Offers BSc, MSc, and PhD programs in Computer Science. Facilities include computer labs, research centers, and innovation hubs.

name: University of Ghana Business School
description: Premier business education institution in West Africa offering undergraduate, graduate, and executive education programs in business administration.

name: Department of Geography and Resource Development
description: Offers undergraduate and graduate programs in Geography, Resource Development, and Environmental Science. The department is known for its research in climate change, urban planning, and sustainable development in Africa.

name: UG School of Law
description: The University of Ghana School of Law serves as the oldest law school in Ghana

name: Department of Chemistry
description: The Department of Chemistry (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) offers BSc, MPhil and PhD programmes in chemistry, with teaching and research laboratories.

name: Department of Home Science
description: Teaching facility for Home Science programmes, today organised under the Family and Consumer Sciences programmes of the College of Basic and Applied Sciences.

name: Department of Political Science
description: The Department of Political Science (College of Humanities) offers undergraduate and graduate programmes in political science and public administration.

name: Department of Psychology
description: The Department of Psychology (College of Humanities) trains students in clinical, social, developmental and industrial/organisational psychology.

name: Department of Information Studies
description: The Department of Information Studies (College of Education), formerly Library and Archival Studies, trains professionals in librarianship, archives and records management.

name: Department of Animal Biology
description: The Department of Animal Biology and Conservation Science (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) focuses on zoology, entomology and wildlife conservation.

name: Department of Marine and Fisheries Sciences
description: The Department of Marine and Fisheries Sciences (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) teaches and researches oceanography, fisheries and coastal resource management.

name: Department of Educational Studies and Leadership (DESL)
description: The Department of Educational Studies and Leadership (DESL), College of Education, offers programmes in educational administration and leadership.

name: Department of Teacher Education
description: The Department of Teacher Education (College of Education) trains teachers and runs the Post-Graduate Diploma in Education programme.

name: International Programmes Office
description: The International Programmes Office handles admissions, exchange programmes and support services for international students at the University of Ghana.

name: Jones Quartey Building (JQB)
description: The Jones Quartey Building (JQB) is one of the busiest lecture blocks on campus, hosting large undergraduate classes across many programmes.

name: Institute of African Studies
description: The Institute of African Studies, founded in 1961, is a leading centre for research into African cultures, languages, history, arts and development.

name: Department of Adult Education
description: The Department of Adult Education and Human Resource Studies (College of Education) runs adult learning, extension and human-resource development programmes.

name: Department of Archaeology
description: The Department of Archaeology and Heritage Studies (College of Humanities) is one of the oldest archaeology departments in West Africa and runs its own museum.

name: School of Continuing and Distance Education
description: The School of Continuing and Distance Education (College of Education) coordinates distance-learning and continuing-education programmes across Ghana.

name: Department of Earth Science (Geology)
description: The Department of Earth Science (formerly Geology), College of Basic and Applied Sciences, teaches geology, hydrogeology and mineral exploration.

name: Centre for International Affairs
description: The Centre for International Affairs coordinates the University's international partnerships, memoranda of understanding and collaborations.

name: Department of Physics
description: The Department of Physics (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) offers programmes in physics and materials science, with teaching and research laboratories.

name: Department of Plant and Environmental Biology
description: The Department of Plant and Environmental Biology (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) covers botany, plant ecology and environmental biology.

name: School of Pharmacy
description: The School of Pharmacy (College of Health Sciences) trains pharmacists through the Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) programme.

name: Department of Biochemistry
description: The Department of Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) offers programmes in biochemistry and molecular life sciences and hosts the WACCBIP research centre.

name: School of Nursing and Midwifery
description: The School of Nursing and Midwifery (College of Health Sciences) trains nurses and midwives at undergraduate and graduate levels.

name: Department of French
description: The Department of French (College of Humanities) teaches French language, literature and francophone studies.

name: Institute of Statistical, Social and Economic Research (ISSER)
description: The Institute of Statistical, Social and Economic Research (ISSER) is UG's premier policy research institute, known for the annual State of the Ghanaian Economy report.

name: Department of Animal Science
description: The Department of Animal Science (School of Agriculture, College of Basic and Applied Sciences) teaches livestock production, nutrition and breeding.

name: Department of Agricultural Economics and Agribusiness
description: The Department of Agricultural Economics and Agribusiness (School of Agriculture) trains students in agricultural economics, finance and agribusiness management.

name: School of Agriculture
description: The School of Agriculture (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) coordinates the crop science, soil science, animal science and agribusiness departments, with research farms at Legon, Nungua and Kade.

name: Biotechnology Laboratory
description: Laboratory facility supporting teaching and research in molecular biology and biotechnology under the College of Basic and Applied Sciences.

name: Centre for Gender Studies and Advocacy (CEGENSA)
description: The Centre for Gender Studies and Advocacy (CEGENSA) leads research, teaching and advocacy on gender equity across the University.

name: Department of Crop Science
description: The Department of Crop Science (School of Agriculture) covers agronomy, horticulture and plant breeding.

name: Department of Music
description: The Department of Music (School of Performing Arts) teaches African and Western music theory, performance and composition.

name: CERSGIS – Remote Sensing & GIS Lab
description: The Centre for Remote Sensing and Geographic Information Services (CERSGIS) provides GIS and remote-sensing research, training and mapping services.

name: Department of Economics
description: The Department of Economics (College of Humanities) is one of the oldest economics departments in sub-Saharan Africa, offering BA, MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Research and Innovation Office Complex
description: The Office of Research, Innovation and Development (ORID) coordinates research grants, partnerships and innovation across the University.

name: Department of Biomedical Engineering
description: The Department of Biomedical Engineering (School of Engineering Sciences) trains engineers in medical devices and health technology.

name: New N Block
description: The New N Block is a modern multi-purpose lecture complex serving large classes across the social sciences and humanities.

name: Centre for Climate Change and Sustainability Studies (C3SS)
description: The Centre for Climate Change and Sustainability Studies (C3SS) coordinates interdisciplinary climate research and graduate programmes.

name: GCB Lecture Building
description: Modern lecture complex funded by GCB Bank, hosting large undergraduate lectures.

name: Department of Sociology
description: The Department of Sociology (College of Humanities) offers programmes in sociology and social policy.

name: School of Graduate Studies
description: The School of Graduate Studies administers admissions, supervision and regulations for all masters and doctoral programmes; the building also hosts the GRASAG secretariat.

name: Department of Modern Languages
description: The Department of Modern Languages (College of Humanities) teaches languages including Arabic, Chinese, Kiswahili, Russian and Spanish.

name: Department of History
description: The Department of History (College of Humanities) offers programmes in Ghanaian, African and global history.

name: Merian Institute for Advanced Studies in Africa (MIASA)
description: The Merian Institute for Advanced Studies in Africa (MIASA), a Ghanaian-German institute hosted at UG, hosts international fellows researching sustainable governance.

name: Maison Française Legon
description: Maison Française Legon promotes French language and culture through courses and cultural events, in partnership with the French Embassy in Ghana.

name: Department of Soil Science
description: The Department of Soil Science (School of Agriculture) teaches soil fertility, conservation and land management.

name: Department of Family and Consumer Sciences
description: The Department of Family and Consumer Sciences (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) covers foods and nutrition, textiles and family resource management.

name: UG Creche and Kindergarten School
description: The University of Ghana Crèche and Kindergarten provides early-childhood care and education for children of staff, students and the surrounding community.

name: Mfodwo Complex (N Block)
description: The Mfodwo Complex (N Block) is a lecture and training facility used for classes, workshops and professional programmes.

name: School of Social Sciences
description: The School of Social Sciences (College of Humanities) coordinates departments including Economics, Political Science, Sociology, Psychology and Geography.

name: CSPS - Centre for Social Policy Studies
description: The Centre for Social Policy Studies (CSPS) researches social policy, poverty and social protection in Ghana.

name: Department for the Study of Religions
description: The Department for the Study of Religions (College of Humanities) studies African traditional religions, Christianity, Islam and comparative religion.

name: Department of Philosophy and Classics
description: The Department of Philosophy and Classics (College of Humanities) teaches philosophy, logic, ethics and classical studies.

name: Economic Policy Management Programme Office
description: The Economic Policy Management (EPM) programme office runs a graduate programme training economic policy analysts for Ghana and the wider African region.

name: School of Public Health
description: The School of Public Health (College of Health Sciences) offers MPH and research programmes in epidemiology, health policy and population health.

name: Department of Mathematics
description: The Department of Mathematics (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) offers programmes in pure and applied mathematics.

name: Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science
description: The Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) trains statisticians and actuaries.

name: West African Genetic Medicine Centre (WAGMC)
description: The West African Genetic Medicine Centre (WAGMC) is a centre of excellence for genetic medicine, genetic counselling and genomics research and training.

name: School of Engineering Sciences
description: The School of Engineering Sciences (College of Basic and Applied Sciences) offers programmes in biomedical, computer, food process, agricultural and materials science engineering.

name: School of Performing Arts
description: The School of Performing Arts comprises the Departments of Music, Dance Studies and Theatre Arts, and stages productions at the Efua Sutherland Drama Studio.

name: Legon Hall
description: One of the premier residential halls on campus, housing both undergraduate and graduate students. Features dining facilities and common areas.

name: Commonwealth Hall
description: Male residential hall known as "Vandals". Provides accommodation and dining services for students with various social and academic facilities.

name: Volta Hall
description: Originally an all-female hall, now co-ed. Features residential facilities, dining hall, and recreational areas for students.

name: Akuafo Hall
description: The Akuafo Hall also known as the Hall of Excellence is the Second residential Hall established in UG. It is named as Akuafo Hall in appreciation to the generous gesture of the cocoa farmers who contributed huge sums of money to its establishment

name: Akuafo Hall Annex
description: The Akuafo Hall currently has four annex buildings, i.e. Annex A, B, C, and D. These structures were set up to support the increasing student population

name: Mensah Sarbah Hall
description: Mensah Sarbah Hall is the "youngest" of the 5 traditional Halls of residence at the University of Ghana. It was opened in October 1963.

name: Vikings Hostel
description: This is a private hostel owned by the alumni of the Mensah Sarbah Hall. The project was funded by Cidan Ivestments Ltd.

name: Legon Hall Annex
description: As part of the Main Hall, the premier hall has three annex buildings. i.e. Annex A,B and C.

name: Mensah Sarbah Annex
description: Has four annex buildings. Annex A, B, C and D.

name: Valco Trust Hostel
description: Valco as is popularly referred to is adjacent the Vikings Hostel and behind the Mensah Sarbah Main Hall

name: Old Pentagon Blocks
description: This is the Ghana Hostels Ltd flats that started the name Pentagon. The individual buildings that forms the old pentagon blocks are Addis-Ababa Court, Kampala Court, Dar es Salaam Court and Nairobi Court

name: Pent Hostel Block A
description: Currently known as the Africa Union Halls, the Pent Hostels were built by SSNIT. It is arguably the most popular residential facility of the UG campus

name: Pent Hostel Block B
description: Currently known as the Africa Union Halls, the Pent Hostels were built by SSNIT. It is arguably the most popular residential facility of the UG campus

name: Pent Hostel Block C
description: Currently known as the Africa Union Halls, the Pent Hostels were built by SSNIT. It is arguably the most popular residential facility of the UG campus

name: Evandy Hostel
description: Currently Evandy Hall and this was turned into a hall after the tenancy agreement with the university elapsed and ownership transferred to University authority.

name: Bani Hostel
description: Initially a private hostel and later had transferred to the status of a hall after the tenancy agreement with the university had elapsed

name: TF Hostel
description: The Teachers Fund Hostel is currently known as the James Topp Nelson Yankah Hall

name: Jubilee Hall
description: Opposite the International Students Hall, the Jubille Hall was built to commemorate the school's Golden Jubilee celebration

name: International Student Hostel
description: The Teachers Fund Hostel is currently known as the James Topp Nelson Yankah Hall

name: Dr. Hilla Limann Hall
description: The first of the University of Ghana Enterprise Limited (UGEL) hostels to be completed.t was inaugurated in July 2010, during which the Vice-Chancellor announced the decision to name it after Dr. Hilla Limann, a former President of the Republic of Ghana.

name: Alexander Kwapong Hall
description: Named after Professor Alexander Kwapong a former Vice-Chancellor and Chairman of the Council of State.

name: Elizabeth Sey Hall
description: The second of the newer halls built by University of Ghana Enterprise Limited (UGEL) Hostels to be completed. It was inaugurated in July 2010 and was named after the first female graduate of the university, Elizabeth Frances Baaba Sey

name: Jean Nelson Akah Hall
description: Jean Nelson Aka Hall is one of the four UGEL halls opened in 2010/2011, named in honour of Jean Nelson Aka, one of the first two women to graduate from the University of Ghana.

name: Central Cafeteria
description: Main student dining facility serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. Offers a variety of local and continental dishes.

name: Legon Hospital
description: University hospital providing healthcare services to students, staff and the surrounding community. Offers emergency and outpatient services.

name: University of Ghana Sports Stadium
description: University sports facilities including football stadium, tennis courts, basketball courts, swimming pool, and gymnasium.

name: UG Banking Square
description: Full-service bank branches located on campus offering banking services to students, staff and visitors. Includes ATMs and Forex services

name: ECOWAS Coastal & Marine Resources Management Centre
description: Regional ECOWAS centre hosted at the University of Ghana for training and cooperation in coastal and marine resources management in West Africa.

name: Ghana Korea Information Access Centre
description: The Ghana-Korea Information Access Centre, established with KOICA support, provides free ICT facilities, internet access and digital-skills training.

name: University of Ghana Basic School
description: The University Basic School, originally established in 1955 as the University Primary School, is a prestigious co-educational institution located on a scenic, dedicated section of the university campus. It was originally founded to provide top-tier education for the children of university faculty and staff.

name: Legon Nightmarket
description: The University of Ghana Night Market is the vibrant, beating commercial heart of the campus community. Though it operates throughout the day, it truly comes alive after sundown as a bustling hub of commerce, social interaction, and student nightlife.Use the referral code (FRAN-3806) for freebies.

name: Pizza King
description: Pizza King Gh is a staple campus pizzeria located directly at Pentagon Hostel Block C. It is widely celebrated among students as a lively, trendy chill spot to enjoy freshly baked, handcrafted comfort food.

name: Bobalicious Spot
description: Bobalicious Ghana is rapidly expanding as one of Accra's premier bubble tea brands, known heavily for prioritizing high-quality flavor and a hygienic brewing environment. To the delight of the student body, they opened a dedicated campus branch situated at the Pentagon Hostel Block C bus stop.

name: Sweet Top Bites
description: Sweet Top Bites is a highly rated, woman-owned fast-food spot positioned perfectly for the student community near the Legon Shell station, right behind the Pentagon (Pent) Hostel. It has earned a reputation for serving big, flavor-packed portions with great value..
